Open the [import prototype](http://maker:4001/index.html?flow=import). Select **Import browser bookmarks**, choose the simulated bookmark file, review the summary, then select **Import 247 bookmarks**. Confirm that the resulting cards retain their names and dates and show former folders as labels.

I’ve assumed import uses the bookmark file your browser exports, previews what was found before changing the library, converts folders into labels, and preserves original saved dates whenever the file contains them.
